title: Verifiers
description: The checks a target repository declares for Factorial to run on every change before it opens or updates a pull request, kept at .factorial/verifiers.json. Read from the base branch, never from the branch under test. Each verifier runs at the tested commit, in order, in a fresh session on Factorial's verifier Runtime, which can call no model and reach none of Factorial's data. A repository without the file is not verified, and its pull requests say so.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

verifiers.description: Run in this order, each on the same commit. A required verifier that does not pass stops the rest. Names are unique.

name.description: Names the verifier in the pull request and the artefact store (verify/<name>/).

kind.description: command: a shell command run by bash in the repository's root, as an unprivileged user with no credentials. The sandbox smoke test (#51) adds a kind.

run.description: The command, such as "npm ci && npm test". Exit status 0 is a pass. npm installs come from Factorial's npm mirror.

required.description: true: the change opens or updates no pull request unless this verifier passes. false: its result is shown, and the list goes on whatever it is.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the command may run before it is stopped and recorded as timed-out. At most 3300: a session command runs for at most an hour, and the rest is the margin for starting it.
